scope.description: Value-ballot preservation across the PrepareReply transport, for producer-established live instance state in fixed-membership volatile EPaxos.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine producer and uncorrupted complete message bytes.
Producer is handlePrepare after an actual PreAccept-established state; observation is of the same reply and instance.
excluded: No assertion that the prior preaccepted command must be selected or committed.
No cluster agreement violation, client completion failure, automatic recovery trigger or crash-restart guarantee.
No attribution of recovery self-reply relabeling to serialization.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Manual constructor-equivalent state uses bounded rows and channels rather than allocating MAX_INSTANCE and starting run goroutines.
Buffered in-memory streams replace peer sockets; actual SendMsg and codecs execute unchanged. No bytes or protocol fields are edited.
Driver calls synchronous handlers, delivers one generated PreAccept and one generated Prepare, and leaves other generated messages pending.
Explicit startRecoveryForInstance substitutes for automatic scanner scheduling; no automatic continuation or deadline assertion.
No background goroutines, files or connections require cleanup; test terminates after decoding the reply.

plan_uncertainties: A representation violation is not a proved consensus decision violation.
Self-reply relabeling and automatic trigger reachability are independent and excluded.
